slipwaddle: A small navy penguin lying flat on its tummy with its head up, closed happy eyes, an orange beak and flipper, a white oval belly at its front, and small cyan snow puffs behind it.
sledwaddle: A bigger flat penguin with an orange curl on its head, closed happy eyes, an orange flipper, a white oval belly at its front and the small cyan snow puffs behind it.
blizzwaddle: The biggest flat penguin: a spiky orange crest on its head, orange fins along its back, an orange flipper, a white oval belly at its front and small cyan snow puffs behind it.
oinkle: A small pink piglet with a long low body and a round head set forward, a flat round snout disc, two triangle ears, dark eyes and a short stub of tail on its rump.
snortle: A bigger pink pig: the head sticks out in front of the long body, with a snout disc, triangle ears, a tuft of pink bubbles on top and the stub tail. No flank oval.
tuskoink: The biggest pig: head forward of the long body, a snout disc with a small white tusk angled up beside it, a tuft of pink bubbles on top, triangle ears, pink spikes along its back and the stub tail.
cubbun: A small tan bear sitting up and hugging a big red heart: both tan arms cross over the middle of the heart and the paws meet in front of it, with the heart's two round lobes showing above the arms and its point below.
brambun: A bigger bear with a green leaf sprout on its head, hugging the same big red heart with both arms across its middle and the paws meeting in front of it.
grizzbun: The biggest bear: a russet leaf crown and two small arched brows on its head, hugging the big red heart with both arms across its middle and the paws meeting in front of it.
spudsy: A small round tan potato with one tiny green sprout on top, brown bumps, freckles, two short arms that both show, and four stubby feet.
tatertot: A bigger, much taller potato shaped like a tater tot, with a green leaf and brown bumps on top, two arms that both show, and four stubby feet.
hashbrawn: The biggest potato, round again: a tuft of green leaves and brown bumps on top, two long arms that both show, and four feet.
cloudlamb: A pale blue-white cloud-shaped sheep floating just above the ground, with puffs of cloud on its top, small pale ears and a ring of puffs underneath, eyes closed.
cumulamb: A bigger floating cloud sheep with more puffs on top and underneath, and two golden crescent horns on the sides of its head.
fluffasus: The biggest cloud sheep: a pale blue-lilac cloud body with closed eyes, puffs along its top, a ring of white puffs underneath, a small blue ear, and a fan of peach feather-lobe wings swept back off its rump. It floats a little over its shadow. No horns are visible.
glimbug: A dark purple bug with a round head on a pear-shaped belly, floating just above its shadow, with two pale yellow antennae, two small yellow eyes inside the head outline, a small smile, a wide yellow wing out to the side and a big glowing pale-yellow lobe behind it. No crown yet.
glimmerbug: A bigger dark bug above its shadow, with the same round head and belly, a crown of pale yellow spikes over its antennae, the yellow wing and the big glowing lobe.
beaconfly: The biggest dark bug above its shadow: a wider yellow wing than Glimmerbug's that stays inside the frame, cream round hands at its sides, the spike crown and the tall glowing lobe behind. The wider wing is the outline step up.
lampfin: A round dark-blue fish just over its shadow, with a short beaded cream stalk to a round cream lure, cream fins, two big yellow eyes under small raised brows and a tiny round mouth.
lanternfin: A bigger blue fish above its shadow with a larger cream lure on its stalk, cream fins on its back and tail, big yellow eyes under raised brows and a tiny round mouth.
nightfin: The biggest blue fish: a huge cream lure, cream back fins, two small blue spikes on top of its head clear of the fins, big yellow eyes under raised brows and a tiny round mouth. Epic sparkle tier: a few small white flecks on its body (how many is set by the renderer).
dragofruit: A small round pink dragonfruit sitting on its shadow, with green spikes over its back and top, a spiky green tail, a small pink wing nub on its side, closed happy eyes, a smile and clear pink blush.
drakeberry: A bigger pink dragonfruit sitting on its shadow, with taller green spikes on its back, pink nubs for wings, closed happy eyes and a clear blush on its cheek.
dragonbloom: The biggest dragonfruit, sitting on its shadow: a large pale green wing swept up behind it, green spikes on its back, closed happy eyes, a smile and a clear blush.
quackle: A small yellow rubber duck shaped like a low flat boat, with a wide flat orange bill, closed happy eyes, the back of the hull swept up into a single point, and a short curl of small bubbles above its head.
bubbleduck: A bigger yellow duck: a longer, denser curl of bubbles above its head, the swept-up tail point, with a small bubble shadow trailing beside the hull shadow.
soapduke: The biggest duck: a full ring of round white suds spheres around its neck, wider than its head and showing past the outline on both sides, the bill clear above it, the tallest curl of bubbles arcing back over its hull and the swept-up tail point.
